**Fixes in 2.0.1**
- **Ctrl+Backspace clears the search** instead of deleting the selected history item. (Delete on an empty search, or Ctrl+Delete, still removes an item.)
- **Editor everywhere:** an *Editor* entry in the Settings sidebar, and an Editor button next to Settings in the popup.
- **Windows: no more dark line** along the top edge of the popup.
- **Readable text in light and dark mode:** stronger contrast for times, hints and descriptions, slightly larger small text, and key caps that always show (Enter and Shift are drawn, so they no longer appear blank on Windows). Windows and Linux spell out "Shift" and "Enter".
